verses.1: YHWH, King of Glory, let the sea be filled with blood. YHWH, mighty and powerful, even if Egypt is destroyed, it will not be defeated.
verses.2: May your throne remain stable from all eternity.
verses.3: Let the rivers carry away the sins of Jehovah. Let them carry away the sins of His people.
verses.4: From the depths of great waters, from the depths of the sea, there comes a great power from the depths of the sea. It is the power of Jehovah.
verses.5: May our prayers be accepted by you, O holy house of God. May the Lord bless you for ever.
